answer: Sample a random slice of each agent's work every epoch. Re-execute it on separate hardware. Compare the delta against the submitted output. Fail the sample and lose the epoch's credit. Link two identities and the sampling counter resets to zero, so a farm never accumulates a clean history. Each clone pays the same audit overhead as an honest worker, and a forge of saffron-priced rigs cannot amortize that across a hundred accounts.
